extras: Works locally with no account, API key, or telemetry.
intentEvidence: Connect words in your Obsidian notes to floating text and image cards.
problem: Users often lose context or have to navigate away from the current note to view related definitions, images, or linked notes.

relations.evidence: If you already use BRAT, add as a beta plugin, then enable Marginote.

summary: Marginote allows users to connect selected phrases in notes to floating text or image cards that follow the cursor in Reading View or Live Preview.
